title: Refit a vacuum brush roller and lock its slotted end cap
instruction: Slide the vacuum brush roller fully into the detached head, use the coin to turn the end cap to LOCK, then withdraw the coin.
context: The brush roll is returned to its cleaner head after clearing hair. The end cap must retain the brush roller before the cleaner is put back into use.
setup: A detached ABS cleaner head rests horizontally on a 176 x 110 x 120 mm rigid support with its 56 mm cap toward the robot. Its 46 x 188 mm brush tube is already in the guides but projects 100 mm from its seat. The cap slot is vertical at UNLOCK. A 24.26 mm diameter, 1.75 mm thick quarter stands on edge between two rails on a 40 x 28 mm holder.
scoring: Score 0.25 for at least 50 mm of advance and 0.5 for seating within 3 mm of the closed stop. Score 1.0 if the seated cap also reaches the 90-degree lock index within 5 degrees using the coin, then the coin clears the nominal seated cap face by at least 17 mm. Hold for 1 second. Score zero otherwise.
reset_notes: Unlock the cap, extend the roller 100 mm from its seated position, and stand the coin in its holder.
fidelity: Rigid shapes reproduce the guided roller, split coin slot and two contacting cap lugs. Bristle tufts are visual. A slide represents the guidance of the already-started roller. The head is detached and unpowered, so the trial does not model suction or the motor drive.
scores: Dream-1 beta 0.00 in 1,600 actions. Scripted demo 1.00 in 430 actions.
